title: Time for construction
text:
20.18.210 Time for construction.
Construction of new and converted billboards must be completed within six months after issuance of a permit. One six-month extension may be granted by the planning division upon a showing that the permittee has diligently attempted to complete the installation.
(Ord. No. 17317, § 3, 5-4-2010; Ord. No. 17442, § 48, 10-26-2010; Ord. No. 17960, § 8, 2-19-2013)
